title: Generalized snake posets：只攻击仍开放的 Ehrhart 根位置猜想
summary: The corrected actual-length Ehrhart root-disk conjecture is false. The length-10 regular word LRLRLRLRLR has exactly certified roots outside |t+7|<=6. A separately audited length-9 witness also corrects the reported baseline.
